raw.rationale: Tiaprofenic acid is a non-cytotoxic NSAID whose only annotated targets are COX-1/COX-2, and at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is unlikely to produce lineage-selective killing in PRISM; COX expression is not a strong lineage-specific dependency in these adherent cancer lines, so probabilities should stay near the low base rate with only minor variation. Slight elevations are assigned to lineages with more frequent COX-2/PGE2 pathway activity or mesenchymal/inflammatory programs (colorectal, pancreas, lung, upper aerodigestive, esophagus, gastric, breast), while others remain at or below baseline.
